brand.name: Rawdati
brand.pitch: Enrollment, attendance, billing in dinars and parent communication — all in one place, in Arabic, English and French.

enrollment.title: Online enrollment
enrollment.desc: Complete applications, waitlists and one-click approval.

attendance.title: Attendance and check-in
attendance.desc: Check children and staff in and out, on a Sunday–Thursday week.

billing.title: Billing in DZD
billing.desc: Monthly fees, receipts and payment tracking without the paperwork.

parents.title: Parent portal
parents.desc: Announcements, incidents and classroom moments shared securely.

brand.trust: Built for Algerian nurseries and kindergartens

login.title: Welcome back!
login.subtitle: Sign in to your Rawdati workspace.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.rememberHint: Uncheck on a shared computer or the door tablet — the session then ends when the browser closes.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Get started free in just a few minutes.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account, then come back and sign in.
signup.phoneLoginHint: This number will be your login. If you forget your password, the crèche can reset it for you.
signup.identifierHint: This is what you will sign in with. A phone number works just as well.

errors.emailInUse: An account already exists with this email.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.slugTaken: That address is already taken — please choose another.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.phoneInUse: That number already has an account.
errors.badIdentifier: Enter your email address or your phone number.
errors.phoneConfirmationBlocked: Phone sign-up is not switched on for this space yet. Use an email address, or ask the crèche.
errors.nameTaken: An establishment already has that name. Pick another.

onboarding.createSubtitle: A few details to set up your workspace.
onboarding.centerTypeHint: Pick what fits best — you can change it later in settings.
onboarding.name: Kindergarten name
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
onboarding.workspacesSubtitle: Your account is linked to the following kindergartens.
onboarding.createNewHint: Running a second location? Set up its workspace in a minute.
onboarding.changeableLater: All of this stays editable in the settings.

claim.title: Has your crèche given you a code?
claim.description: Enter it to join the parent portal and find your children.
claim.label: Access code

errors.invalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Ask your crèche for a new one.
errors.alreadyLinked: That parent is already attached to another account.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {Your request is being reviewed} other {Your # requests are being reviewed}}
pending.description: The crèche is looking at your file. The moment they accept it your parent portal opens by itself — there is nothing else for you to do here.

parentPath.title: Enrolling your child?
parentPath.body: Use your crèche's enrolment link, or enter the code they gave you above. No link or code? Contact them directly.

ownerPath.title: Do you run an establishment?
ownerPath.body: Create its workspace in a few minutes.

camp.name: Holiday camp
camp.desc: Seasonal camps run in short sessions.

join.title: Invitation to join a team
join.authIntro: Create an account or sign in to accept the invitation.
join.acceptBody: Accept the invitation to join your kindergarten's team on Rawdati.
join.invalidBody: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask your kindergarten's administrator to send you a new one.
